sources.title: Home · modelindex.dev
sources.snippet: Provenance and cryptographic hashes for public AI models across HuggingFace, ModelScope, CivitAI, and Ollama. Look up any file by hash, browse by org, and verify your downloads on modelindex.dev.

sources.title: Hugging Bay
sources.snippet: Hugging Bay publishes open AI catalog metadata, source provenance, license records, neutral hosted-file inventory, answer packs, and recorded hashes. Canonical bundle verification and runtime readiness remain unknown.

sources.title: Hugging Face - The AI community building the future.
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
